items.name: Report fraud to the FTC
items.description: Report scams, fraud and bad business practices to the Federal Trade Commission.

items.name: FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3)
items.description: Report internet-enabled crime, including online payment, investment and impersonation scams.

items.name: IdentityTheft.gov
items.description: Get a personal recovery plan if someone used your personal information.

items.name: Forward scam texts to 7726
items.description: Forward suspicious text messages to 7726 (SPAM) so your carrier can block them.

items.name: AARP Fraud Watch Network Helpline
items.description: Free help line for fraud victims and their families: 877-908-3360.

items.name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
items.description: Report cyber fraud and financial crime online.

items.name: Cyber fraud helpline: 1930
items.description: Call 1930 as soon as possible after a financial fraud — quick reporting improves the chance of stopping the money.

items.name: Sanchar Saathi (Chakshu)
items.description: Report suspected fraud calls, SMS and WhatsApp messages.

items.name: Your bank or payment provider
items.description: If money has left your account, call your bank using the number on your card — speed matters.

items.name: Local police
items.description: Report fraud to your local police or national fraud reporting service.
